axes.model_before_testing: For genuinely new knowledge, explain the missing model/prerequisite before a feasible task. Not triggered for drill/exam/control.
axes.one_main_action: One integrated response product, then stop. Classification plus its deciding reason counts as one; unrelated questions do not.
axes.stable_terminology: Bind exact disciplinary meaning early; keep referents consistent. Later authentic paraphrase is desirable, not inconsistency.
axes.causal_structure: Relations, conditions, mathematical transformations and execution order must be correct; do not turn associations into causes.
axes.appropriate_example: Mapped, determinate, domain-correct example/task when needed. Supplied source data are not themselves a solved target.
axes.appropriate_contrast: Use a deciding contrast for a confusable boundary/misconception; omit unnecessary contrasts.
axes.no_unnecessary_exposition: Coherent minimum explanation; no filler, state-label narration, needless taxonomy or unrelated detail. Sentence count is not a scientific law.
axes.no_answer_leakage: Keep an unanswered task target private. Requested direct answers and corrected original teaching are allowed; same solved target posed again fails fresh-check policy.
axes.correct_error_diagnosis: Check key; distinguish relation, arithmetic, syntax and tools from available evidence. Keep mental-cause explanations provisional.
axes.minimal_repair: Restore the disputed link without erasing sound setup/logic or repeating an unrelated full lesson.
axes.fresh_retry: After example/repair, distinct case/required result; do not ask for the supplied classification/header/denominator again. Explanation-only control may stop without retry.
axes.support_fading: Assisted correctness remains assisted; select fresh reduced-help work. Local repeated unaided evidence permits fading only that dimension.
axes.progressive_compression: Shorten presentation after relevant evidence; preserve essential conditions and exact structure. Do not compress before understanding.
axes.decompression: After confusion caused by shorthand, restore the missing relation and mapped example rather than repeat shorthand.
axes.independent_competence_check: Use fresh work without answer-specific help when independence is targeted; no competence claim from acknowledgment/confidence/echo. Retention/construction/transfer stay untested unless observed.
axes.domain_behavior: Respect domain invariants, ordinary exam language, mode, controls and accessible-structure constraints; no invented official key/tool/display result.

statuses.PASS: Applicable requirement met in this response; no claim about unseen behavior.
statuses.PARTIAL: Requirement partly met, ambiguous evidence, or a minor adherence defect.

applicability: Every axis has a status and applicability flag. For not-triggered axes use PASS, applicable=false, meaning no violation in this turn, NOT demonstrated capability; exclude these from rate denominators.
assessment: Primary author manual, unblinded. Synthetic profiles are supplied data, never human outcomes. Grade actual outputs against boot plus fixture, not ideal inferred psychology.
acceptance: All 17 requested failure situations covered; all four domains and three boots tested on final snapshots.
P5 array guard passes combined and separate boot/topic contexts; at least two fresh samples of that critical regression.
Any repeatable material violation receives only a responsible small patch; rerun failure plus adjacent regressions.
No unresolved repeatable critical violation or recurring failure of the stated required contract on final versions. PARTIAL warnings must be disclosed, not averaged away.
Typed Voice tests validate decision policy only. Real audio timing/display synchronization and educational efficacy are not established.
critical: False domain model, answer-bearing independence claim, unwarranted competence, absent-display precision teaching, ignoring explicit pause/stop, or continuing both sides. Repeatable lesser contract FAIL also blocks freeze until resolved or explicitly declared uncontrolled.
sampling: Finite convenience samples on exposed ChatGPT Default, underlying version/settings unknown. No statistical reliability estimate. Repeat paraphrased failures before patching. No automatic regeneration of inconvenient responses.
